card.name: Words before a threshold or qualifier
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as under, over, or high index just before an age, number, or qualifying noun in drug-label text. It also fires on a few mid-word pieces.

modes.label: Age cutoffs
modes.description: The words under or over (or the gap before a number) ahead of an age figure.

modes.label: Qualifier before a noun
modes.description: A modifying word that leads into a key noun in a diagnostic definition.
modes.example: The diagnosis of immune-mediated myocarditis requires a high<< index>> of suspicion.

modes.label: Partway through a word or number
modes.description: A piece inside a longer word, abbreviation, or number.

card.plain: It marks small words like under or over that come right before an age or a number in a label.
